BiblicalUsage: Na'ar as a verb means to reject or cast off, and it falls on the holiest things when God judges. In Lamentations 2:7 the Lord has cast off His altar and abhorred His sanctuary, giving its walls into the hand of the enemy, and in Psalm 89:39 the psalmist cries that God has made void the covenant of His servant and profaned his crown.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hardest verses in the Bible are the ones where God Himself seems to cast off what He loved; they are not the end of the story, but they are honest about what sin costs.
